task.title: Exclude Files from Version Control
task.shortdesc: Keep generated files, local settings, and other clutter out of Git with a repository .gitignore or a global ignore file.

context.p:
Ignore rules come in two scopes:
A .gitignore file that is located in the repository and shared with everyone.
A global ignore file that applies to all your repositories. Ignore actions are available for untracked files only.

dlentry.dd: Ignores every file with the same extension. Not available for dotfiles or files that have no extension.
Ignores the folder that contains the selected file. Not available for files at the repository root.
Ignores the selected folder (for a folder selection).
Ignores every file in the selected folder (for a folder selection).

info.p: Each action adds the matching rule to the repository .gitignore file. You can select several untracked resources and ignore them together. The same submenu is also available on the contextual menu for untracked files.
